MenuOverview

### Personal

Secure access to your own Garmin Connect data for individuals who want to explore, analyze, and build personalized experiences using their own data.

### How It Works

Log in to the Garmin Connect website to retrieve your personal API key and generate access tokens for Garmin Connect API requests.

[SET UP NOW](https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken)

### Business

The Garmin Connect Developer Program supports a broad range of organizations, from individual developers and startups to companies operating at significant scale.

### How It Works

Apply for the Garmin Connect Developer Program and create an app with Starter Access. As your business and integration needs evolve, you can request Enterprise Access through Garmin Developer Portal.

[REQUEST NOW](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/forms/StarterGarminConnectDeveloperAccess/)

StarterBUSINESS
